G2000.def:
ἐπισφαλής, -ές
(σφάλλω, to cause to full), [in LXX: Wis.9:14 (cf. -ῶς, Wis.4:4) * ;] 
__1. prone to fall (Plat.). 
__2. dangerous (Hipp., Plut., al.): Actes 27:9.†

G2001.def:
ἐπ-ισχύω 
[in LXX: Sir.29:1, 1Ma.6:6 * ;] 
__1. to make stronger (Sir, l.with). 
__2. to grow stronger; metaphorically, be more urgent: Luc 23:5.†

G2002.def:
ἐπι-σωρεύω 
[in Sm.: Job 14:17, Cantique des cantiques 2:4 * ;] 
to heap together; metaphorically, διδασκάλους, 2 Timothée 4:3.†

G2003.def:
ἐπι-ταγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιτάσσω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 3:16 (פִּתְגָּם), I Esther 1:18, Wis.14:16 18:16 19:6, 3Ma.7:20 * ;] 
= cl., ἐπίταγμα, 
a command, Romains 16:26, 1 Corinthiens 7:6 7:25, 2 Corinthiens 8:8, 1 Timothée 1:1, Tite 1:3 (for use in Inscr. of divine commands, see MM, Exp., xiv); μετὰ πάσης ἐ, with all authority: Tite 2:15.†

G2004.def:
ἐπι-τάσσω 
[in LXX for אָמַר, צָוָה, etc. ;] 
to command, charge: with accusative of thing(s), Luc 14:22; with dative of person(s), Marc 1:27 9:25, Luc 4:36 8:25; id. with accusative of thing(s), Phm 8; id. with inf., Marc 6:39, Luc 8:31, Actes 23:2; id. with imperat., Marc 9:25; with accusative and inf., Marc 6:27.†
SYN.: κελεύω

G2005.def:
ἐπι-τελέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for כָּלָה, עָשָׂה, etc. ;] 
to complete, accomplish, execute: with accusative of thing(s), Romains 15:28, 2 Corinthiens 7:1 8:6 8:11, Philippiens 1:6, Hébreux 8:5; of religious services (cf. Hdt., ii, 37, al.), Hébreux 9:6; art. inf., 2 Corinthiens 8:11. Mid., 
__(a) to complete for oneself, make an end (R, mg.; pass., R, txt; cf. Meyer, in l): Galates 3:3; 
__(b) to pay in full, pay the tax, be subject to: with accusative (cf. Xen., Mem., iv, 8, 8), 1 Pierre 5:9 (pass., RV, etc.; cf. Thayer, see word; ICC, in 1).†

G2006.def:
ἐπιτήδειος, -α, -ον 
[in LXX: 1 Chroniques 28:2, Wis.4:5, 1Ma.4:46, al. ;] 
__1. suitable, convenient, 
__2. useful, necessary: τὰ ἐ., necessaries, Jacques 2:16,†

G2007.def:
ἐπι-τίθημι 
[in LXX for נָתַן, שָׁוָה, etc. ;] 
__1. to lay, set or place upon: with accusative of thing(s), before ἐπί, with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 23:4, Luc 15:5, Jean 9:6 (WH, txt. Jean 9:15), Actes 15:10 28:3; ἐπί, with genitive of thing(s), Matthieu 27:29; ἐν, ib.; with dative of person(s), σταυρόν, Luc 23:26; στέφανον, Jean 19:2; ὄνομα, Marc 3:16-17; πληγάς, Luc 10:30, Actes 16:23; ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Apocalypse 22:18; of the laying on of hands, τ. χεῖρα (-ας), before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 9:18, Marc 16:13, Actes 8:17 9:17; with dative of person(s), Matthieu 19:13, 15, Marc 5:23 6:5 7:32 8:23, Luc 4:40 13:13, Actes 6:6 8:19 9:12 13:3 19:6 28:8, 1 Timothée 5:22. Mid., 
__(a) to provide: Actes 28:10 (RV, put on board; cf. Field, Notes, 149); 
__(b) to throw oneself upon, attack: with dative of person(s), Actes 18:10. 
__2. to add to: Apocalypse 22:18 (see supr., and cf. Swete, in l).†

G2008.def:
ἐπι-τιμάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for גָּעַר, Genèse 37:10, Psaumes 9:5, Zacharie 3:2; Sir.11:7, al. ;] 
__1. to honour. 
__2. to raise in price 
__3. to mete out due measure; 
__(a) to award; 
__(b) to censure, rebuke, admonish: absol., 2 Timothée 4:2; with dative, Matthieu 8:26 17:13 19:13, Marc 4:39 8:32 10:13, Luc 4:39, 41 8:24 9:21, 42 9:55 17:3 18:15 19:39, Ju 9; before ἵνα, Matthieu 12:16 16:20 20:31, Marc 3:12 8:30 10:48, Luc 18:39; before λέγων, λέγει, etc., Matthieu 16:22, Marc 1:25 8:33 9:25, Luc 4:35 23:40.†
SYN.: ἐλέγχω, q.v

G2009.def:
ἐπιτιμία, -ας, ἡ 
(ἐπιτιμάω), [in LXX: Wis_3:10 * ;] 
__1. citizenship, franchise. 
__2. As in Inscr. (LS, see word), LXX, l.with (= cl. τὸ ἐπιτίμιον), punishment, penalty: 2 Corinthiens 2:6.†

G2010.def:
ἐπι-τρέπω 
[in LXX (usually with seel. ἐπιστρ-): Genèse 39:6 (עָזַב), etc. ;] 
__1. to turn to, commit, entrust. 
__2. to yield, permit: 1 Corinthiens 16:7, Hébreux 6:3; with dative of person(s), Marc 5:13, Jean 19:38; id. with inf. (cf. M, Pr., 205), Matthieu 8:21 19:8, Luc 8:32 9:52, 61 Actes 21:39-40 27:3, 1 Timothée 2:12; with inf., Marc 10:4. Pass., with dative and inf., Actes 26:1 28:16, 1 Corinthiens 14:34.†

G2011.def:
ἐπι-τροπή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιτρέπω), [in LXX: 2Ma.13:14 * ;] 
power to decide, authority: Actes 26:12.†

G2012.def:
ἐπίτροπος, -ου, ὁ
(ἐπιτρέπω), [in LXX: 2Ma.11:1 2Mac 13:2 2Mac 14:2 * ;] 
__1. an administrator, a steward: Matthieu 20:3, Luc 8:3. 
__2. a guardian (with genitive of person(s), 2Mac, ll. with): Galates 4:2.†

G2013.def:
ἐπι-τυγχάνω 
[in LXX: Genèse 39:2 (צָלַח hi.), Proverbes 12:27 (חָרַךְ)* ;] 
__1. to light upon. 
__2. to obtain, attain to: Jacques 4:2, with genitive of thing(s) (as in cl.), Hébreux 6:15 11:33; with accusative (late Gk.), Romains 11:7 (Rec. τούτου).†

G2014.def:
ἐπι-φαίνω 
[in LXX for עוּר hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to show forth. 
__2. (= pass. in cl.) to appear: Actes 27:20; with dative of person(s), Luc 1:79; metaphorically, Tite 3:4; with dative, Tite 2:11 (Cremer, 567).†

G2015.def:
ἐπιφάνεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιφανής), [in LXX: 2 Rois 7:23 (יָרֵא), Esther 5:1, Amos 5:22, 2Ma.2:21 2Mac 3:24 2Mac 5:4 2Mac 12:22 2Mac 14:16 2Mac 15:27, 3Ma.2:9 3Mac 5:8 3Mac 5:51,* ;] (in late Gk. and Inscr., frequently of deities, see MM, Exp., xiv) 
a manifestation, appear­ance: 2 Thessaloniciens 2:8, 1 Timothée 6:14, 2 Timothée 1:10 4:1 4:8, Tite 2:13 (cf. M, Th., 148 f.).†

G2016.def:
ἐπιφανής, -ές
(ἐπιφαίνω), [in LXX (see Thayer, see word) for יָרֵא, etc., Juges 13:6, Joël 2:11, 31 al.; 2Ma.6:23, 3Ma.5:35, al. ;] 
renowned, illustrious, notable: Actes 2:20 (LXX) (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†

G2017.def:
ἐπι-φαύσκω
(variant form of ἐπιφώσκω, which see), [in LXX: Job 25:5 (אהל hi.) Job 31:26 41:18 (הָלַל hi.) * ;] 
to shine forth: figuratively, with dative, Éphésiens 5:14 (on seel. -ψαύσει, see ICC, Westc., AR, in l).†

G2018.def:
ἐπι-φέρω 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַח ;] 
__1. to bring upon or against: κρίσιν, Ju 9. 
__2. to impose, inflict: Romains 3:5.†

G2019.def:
ἐπι-φωνέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: I Esther 9:47 AR, 2Ma.1:23, 3Ma.7:13 * ;] 
to call out, shout: with accusative of thing(s), Actes 21:34; with dative of person(s), Actes 22:24; before λέγοντες, Luc 23:21; prat. rect., Actes 12:22.†

G2020.def:
ἐπι-φώσκω 
[in LXX for הָלַל hi., Job 41:18 A (Βא, ἐπιφαύσκ-) * ;] 
__1. to let shine. 
__2. to dawn (cf. MM, Exp., xiv): Luc 23:54; before εἰς, Mat_28:1.†

G2021.def:
ἐπιχειρέω, -ῶ
(χεῖρ), [in LXX for חָשַׁב, Exode 9:25; גָּמַל, 2 Chroniques 20:11, al. ;] 
__1. to pat one's hand to. 
__2. to take in hand, attempt: with inf., Luc 1:1, Actes 9:29 19:13.†

G2022.def:
ἐπι-χέω 
[in LXX chiefly for יָצַק. Genèse 28:18, al. ;] 
to pour upon: Luc 10:34.†

G2023.def:
ἐπι-χορηγέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Sir.25:22, 2Ma.4:9 A * ;] 
to supply, provide: with accusative of thing(s), 2 Pierre 1:5; id. with dative of person(s), 2 Corinthiens 9:10, Galates 3:5; pass., Colossiens 2:19, 2 Pierre 1:11 (cf. χορηγέω, and see MM, Exp., xiv).†

G2024.def:
ἐπι-χορηγία, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιχορηγέω), 
a supply: Éphésiens 4:16, Philippiens 1:19.†

G2025.def:
ἐπι-χρίω 
[in Sm.: Eze.13:10 22:28 * ;] 
to spread on, anoint: with accusative, Jean 9:11; id. before hi-I, with accusative, Jean 9:6 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†

G2026.def:
ἐπ-οικοδομέω, -ῶ 
in NT, always metaphorically, of the spiritual life regarded as a building (Cremer, 449); 
__1. to build upon: 1 Corinthiens 3:10 3:12 3:14; pass., Éphésiens 2:20. 
__2. to build up: Colossiens 2:7, 1 Pierre 2:5 (T, οἰκοδ- WH, Rec.), Ju 20.†

G2027.def:
ἐπι-κέλλω 
of a ship, to run ashore: with accusative, Actes 27:41.†

G2028.def:
ἐπ-ονομάζω 
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] 
to name, call by a name, surname: pass., Romains 2:17.†

G2029.def:
ἐπ-οπτεύω 
[in Sm.: Psaumes 10:14 33:13 * ;] 
to watch (in Hom., as an overseer; cf Ps, ll. with), look upon: 1 Pierre 2:12 3:2.†

G2030.def:
ἐπόπτης, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX (of God): Esther 5:1, 2Ma.3:39 2Mac 7:35, 3Ma.2:21 * ;] 
__1. an overseer (LXX, ll. with). 
__2. a spectator: 2 Pierre 1:16 (of ἐ. as applied to God, see parallels in Inscr., MM, Exp., xiv; of the use of this term in the mysteries, see Mayor on 2Pe, l.with; Thayer, see word).†

G2031.def:
ἔπος, -εος (-ους), τό 
[in LXX: Zacharie 7:3, Sir.44:5 * ;] 
a word: ὡς ἔ. εἰπεῖν (cl.), so to speak: Hébreux 7:9.†
SYN.: λόγος, reasoned speech; ῥῆμα, mere articulated utterance; ἔ., the articulated expression of a thought

G2032.def:
ἐπουράνιος, -ον
(οὐρανός), [in LXX: Psaumes 68:14 (שַׁדַּי), DA TH Daniel 4:23 A (שָׁמַיִם) 2Ma.3:39, 3Ma.6:28 3Mac 7:6, 4Ma.4:11 AR, 4Ma.11:3 א* ;] 
in or of heaven, heavenly (in Hom., of the Gods): οἱ ἐ., opposite to ἐπίγειοι and καταχθόνιοι, Philippiens 2:10; to χοϊκός, 1 Corinthiens 15:48-49; σώματα (see Lft., Col., 376), 1 Corinthiens 15:40; βασιλεία, 2 Timothée 4:18; παπρίς, Hébreux 11:16; Ἱερουσαλήμ, Hébreux 12:22; κλῆσις (cf. Lft. on Philippiens 3:14), Hébreux 3:1; τὰ ἐ., Hébreux 8:5 9:23; opposite to ἐπίγειος, Jean 3:12; id., of the heavenly regions, Éphésiens 1:3, 20 2:6 3:10 6:12; ἡ δωρεὰ ἡ ἐ., Hébreux 6:4 (Cremer, 468).†

G2033.def:
ἐπτά, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl., 
seven: Matthieu 12:45 18:22 (cf. ἑβδομηκοντάκις), Marc 8:5, al.; οἱ ἐ, Actes 21:8

G2034.def:
ἐπτάκις 
adv., 
seven times: Matthieu 18:21-22, Luc 17:4.†

G2036.def: εἶπον, 2 aorist of obsolete present ἔπω (cf. Veitch), used as aorist of λέγω, which see

G2037.def:
Ἐραστος, -ου, ὁ 
Erastus; 
__1. a companion of St. Paul, Actes 19:22, and prob. 2 Timothée 4:20. 
__2. The treasurer of Corinth, Romains 16:23.†

G2038.def:
ἐργάζομαι
(ἔργον), [in LXX for עָבַד, פָּעַל, עָשָׂה, etc. ;] 
__1. intrans., 
__(a) to work, labour: Matthieu 21:28, Luc 13:14, Jean 5:17 9:4 b, Actes 18:3, 1 Corinthiens 9:6, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:10-12; τ. χερσίν, 1 Corinthiens 4:12, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:11; νυκτὸς κ. ἡαέρας, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:9, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:8; of working for pay, Matthieu 21:28; for reward, Romains 4:4-5; 
__(b) to work at a trade or business, to trade: before Iv (Dem.), Matthieu 25:16. 
__2. Trans., 
__(a) to work, work out, do, produce, perform: with accusative, 2 Corinthiens 7:10, Colossiens 3:23, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:11, Jacques 1:20, 2Jn.8, before εἰς, III Jn 5; ἔργον, Actes 13:41 (LXX); id. before εἰς, Matthieu 26:10; ἐν, Marc 14:6; ἔργα, Jean 3:21; τὰ ἔ. τ. θεοῦ, Jean 6:28 9:4; τὸ ἔ. κυρίου, 1 Corinthiens 16:10; τ. ἀγαθόν, Romains 2:10, Éphésiens 4:28 (see AR, Eph.) 190); id. before πρός, Galates 6:10; κακόν, before dative of person(s) (more frequently dupl. accusative, in cl.), Romains 13:10; δικαιοσύνην, Actes 10:35, Hébreux 11:33; ἀνομίαν, Matthieu 7:23; ἁμαρτίαν, Jacques 2:9; σημεῖον, Jean 6:30; τ. ἱερά, 1 Corinthiens 9:13; τ. θάλασσαν (work the sea, i.e. make one's living from it), Apocalypse 18:17; 
__(b) to work for, earn by working (cl.): Jean 6:27 (cf. κατ-, περι-, προσ-εργάζομαι; Cremer, 258; on the force of the aorist of this verb, see M, Pr., 116).†

G2039.def:
ἐργασία, -ας, ἡ
(ἔργον), [in LXX for מְלָאכָה, עֲבֹדָה, etc. ;] 
__1. work, business: Actes 16:16, 19 19:24-25; δὸς ἐ. (Lat. da operam), Luc 12:58. 
__2. working, performance: Éphésiens 4:19.†

G2040.def:
ἐργάτης, -ου, ὁ
(ἐργάζομαι, which see), [in LXX: Wis.17:17, Sir.19:1 40:18, 1Ma.3:6 * ;] 
__1. prop., a field labourer, husbandman: Matthieu 9:37-38 20:1-2, 8, Luc 10:2, Jacques 5:4 (cf. Wis, l.with). 
__2. Generally, a workman, labourer: Matthieu 10:10, Luc 10:7, Actes 19:25 (opposite to τεχνίτης), 1 Timothée 5:18; of Christian teachers, 2 Corinthiens 11:13, Philippiens 3:2, 2 Timothée 2:15. 
__3. a worker, doer: τ. ἀδικίας, Luc 13:27 (cf. 1Mac, l.with).†

G2041.def:
ἔργον, -ου, τό (originally Ϝέργον, work), [very frequently in LXX, chiefly for מַשֶׂה, מְלָאכָה, also for עֲבֹדָה, פֹּעַל, etc. ;] 
__1. work, task, employment: Marc 13:34, Jean 4:34 17:4, Actes 13:2, Philippiens 1:22 2:30, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:13, al.; of an enterprise or undertaking (Deutéronome 15:10, Wis.2:12), Actes 5:38. 
__2. a deed, action: Tite 1:16, Jacques 1:25 . listing, from λόγος, Luc 24:19, Romains 15:18, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:17, 1 Jean 3:18; ἐν λόγοις κ. ἔ., Actes 7:22; of acts of God, Jean 9:3, Actes 13:41" (LXX), Hébreux 4:10, Apocalypse 15:3; of Christ, Matthieu 11:2; esp. in Jo, e.g. 5:20, 36 7:3 10:38 14:11, 12 15:24; in ethical sense, of human actions (AR, Eph., 190), bad or good, Matthieu 23:3, Luc 11:48, Jean 3:20, 21 Jacques 2:14ff. 3:13, Apocalypse 2:5 3:8; τὸ ἔ., collectively, Galates 6:4, Jacques 1:4, 1 Pierre 1:17, Apocalypse 22:12; τὸ ἔ. τ. νόμου, Romains 2:15; ἔ. ἀγαθόν, Romains 2:7, Colossiens 1:10, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:17, Tite 1:16, al.; καλόν, Matthieu 26:10, Marc 14:6; pl. (as frequently in cl.), Matthieu 5:16, 1 Timothée 5:10, 25 Hébreux 10:24; ἔ. πίστεως, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:3, 2 Thessaloniciens 1:11; ἔ. πονηρά, Colossiens 1:21, 2Jo.11; νέκρα, Hébreux 6:1 9:14; ἄκαρπα, Éphésiens 5:11; ἔ. ἀσεβείας, Ju 15; τ. σκότους, Romains 13:12, Éphésiens 5:11; ἔ. νόμου, Romains 3:20, 28 Galates 2:16 3:2, 5 10. 
__3. that which is wrought or made, a work: 1 Corinthiens 3:13-15; τ. χειρῶν, Actes 7:41; of the works of God, Hébreux 1:10; γῆ κ. τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔ., 2 Pierre 3:10; τὸ ἔ. τ. θεοῦ, Romains 14:20.

G2042.def:
ἐρεθίζω 
[in LXX: Dan LXX 11:10, 25 (גָּרָה hithp.), 1Ma.15:40, 2Ma.14:17, etc. ;] 
__1. to stir up, provoke (as in cl.): Colossiens 3:21. 
__2. In good sense (cf. ἐρεθισμός, excitement, in MGr.), to stir up, stimulate: 2 Corinthiens 9:2.†

G2043.def:
ἐρείδω
(chiefly in poets and late prose for ἐρυγγάνω), [in LXX for תָּמַךְ (Proverbes 4:4 5:5 11:16, al.), etc. ;] 
to prop, fix firmly: act., as mid., ἐρείσασα, of a ship driving ashore (RV, struck), Actes 27:41.†

G2044.def:
ἐρεύγομαι 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַג, Osée 11:10, Amos 3:4, 8 al.; also for נָבַע, Psaumes 19:2, etc. ;] 
__1. to spit or spue out. 
__2. Prop., of oxen (Hom.), to bellow, roar; whence, as in LXX, to speak aloud, utter: Matthieu 13:35 (LXX). (For other examples of softened force of words in late Gk., cf. σκύλλω, τρώγω, χορτάζω.) †

G2045.def:
ἐραυνάω, -ῶ late form of ἐρευνάω (Rec., ll. with; cf. Bl., § 6, 1; M, Pr., 46), 
[in LXX, ἐρευν- (exc. 1 Chroniques 19:3 A), for חָפַשׂ pi., חָקַר, etc. ;] 
to search, examine: Jean 7:52; with accusative of thing(s), Jean 5:39, Romains 8:27, 1 Corinthiens 2:10, Apocalypse 2:23; before orat. obliq., 1 Pierre 1:11.†
SYN.: see: ἐξετάζω

G2046.def:
λέγω, 
[in LXX very freq., chiefly for אמר; λέγει for נְאֻם, Genèse 22:16, al. ;] 
__1. in Hom., to pick out, gather, reckon, recount.
__2. In Hdt. and Att., to say, speak, affirm, declare: absol., Actes 13:15, 24:10; before orat. dir., Matthieu 9:34, Marc 3:11, Jean 1:29, al.; before ὅτι recit., Marc 3:21, Luc 1:24, Jean 6:14, al.; accusative and inf., Luc 11:18, Jean 12:29, al.; after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, Matthieu 11:17, al.; ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, Words, 24 ff.), Matthieu 25:9, Marc 3:33, 7:28, Luc 24:6, 7, al.; of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, Matthieu 3:9, Luc 3:8, al.; of writing, 2 Corinthiens 8:8, Philippiens 4:11, al.; λέγει ἡ γραφή, Romains 4:3, Jacques 2:23, al.; with accusative of thing(s), Luc 8:8, 9:33, Jean 5:34, al.; σὺ λέγεις (a non-committal phrase; Swete, Mk., 359, 369f.), Matthieu 27:11, Marc 15:2, Luc 23:3, Jean 18:37; with dative of person(s), before orat. dir., Matthieu 8:20, Marc 2:17, al. mult.; id. before ὅτι, Matthieu 3:9, al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, etc., Marc 4:41, Jean 11:56, Hébreux 9:5, al.; to mean (cl.), Marc 14:71, Jean 6:71, 1 Corinthiens 10:29, al.; to call, name, Marc 10:18; pass., Matthieu 9:9, Marc 15:7, al (cf. ἀντι-, δια- (-μαι), προ-, συλ-λέγω). 
SYN.: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr., Syn., Ixxvi; Thayer, see word λαλέω).

G2047.def:
ἐρημία, -ας, ἡ
(ἔρημος), [in LXX: Ésaïe 60:20, Eze.35:4 (חָרַב, חׇרְבָּה), Eze.35:9 (שְׁמָמָה), Wis.17:17, Sir.47:17, Bar.4:33, 4Ma.18:8 * ;] 
a solitude, wilderness: Matthieu 15:33, Marc 8:4, 2 Corinthiens 11:26, Hébreux 11:38.†

G2048.def:
ἔρημος
(in older Gk. ἔρῆμος), -ον [in LXX chiefly for מִדְבָּר ;] 
solitary, lonely, desolate, deserted: 
__(a) of persons, γυνή, Galates 4:27 (LXX); 
__(b) of places, Matthieu 14:13, 15 23:38 (WH, om.), Marc 1:36 6:32, Luc 4:42 9:12, al.; as subst., ἡ ἔ. (sc. χώρα; as in Hdt., ii, 32, al.), the desert, Matthieu 3:1, 3, Marc 1:3-4, Jean 3:14, al.; pl., αἱ ἔ., desert places, Luc 1:80 5:16 8:29

G2049.def:
ἐρημόω, -ῶ
(ἔρημος), [in LXX for חָרַב hi., שָׁמֵם ni., etc. ;] 
to desolate, lay waste: Matthieu 12:25, Luc 11:17, Apocalypse 17:16 18:16, 19.†

G2050.def:
ἐρήμωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐρημόω), [in LXX for שָׁמֵם, שָׁמֵם, Lévitique 26:34-35, Psaumes 73:10, Daniel 9:27 11:31 12:11, al.; חׇרְבָּה, Jérémie 7:34 22:5, al. ;] 
a making desolate, laying waste: Luc 21:20; βδέλυγμα ἐρημώσεως (Da, ll. with, 1Ma.1:54), Matthieu 24:15" (LXX), Marc 13:14.†

G2051.def:
ἐρίζω
(ἔρις), [in LXX for מָרָה, etc. ;] 
to wrangle, strive: Matthieu 12:19 (LXX, κεκράζεται).†

G2052.def:
ἐριθία 
(T, cl., -εία), -ας, ἡ, [in Sm.: Eze.23:11 * ;] (on the origin and history of the word, see Hort, Ja., 81 fly.; Ellic. on Galates 5:20; Cremer, 262) 
ambition, self-seeking, rivalry: Jacques 3:14, 16; κατ᾽ ἐριθίαν, Philippiens 2:3; οἱ ἐξ ἐ., Romains 2:8, Philippiens 1:17; pl. (Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk., 153), 2 Corinthiens 12:20, Galates 5:20.†

G2053.def:
ἔριον, -ου, τό 
[in LXX for צֶמֶר, Lévitique 13:47, Ésaïe 1:18, al. ;] 
wool: Hébreux 9:19, Apocalypse 1:14.†

G2054.def:
ἔρις, -ιδος accusative, ἔριν (on the declension, see B1., § 8, 3; WH, App., 157), ἡ, 
[in LXX: Psaumes 139:20, Sir.28:11 40:5, 9 * ;] 
strife, wrangling, contention: Romains 1:29 13:13, 1 Corinthiens 3:3, 2 Corinthiens 12:20, Galates 5:20, Philippiens 1:15, 1 Timothée 6:4, Tite 3:9; pl. (see: ἐριθία), Romains 13:13, WH, mg., 1 Corinthiens 1:11, Ga, l.with, WH, mg.†

G2055.def:
ἐρίφιον, -ου, τό
(dim, of ἔριφος, which see) [in LXX: Tob.2:13 * ;] 
Matthieu 25:33, Luc 15:29 (ἔριφον, WH, txt.).†

G2056.def:
ἔριφος, -ου 
[in LXX chiefly for גְּדִי ;] 
a kid: Matthieu 25:32, Luc 15:29, WH, txt.†

G2057.def:
Ἑρμᾶς, -ᾶ, accusative, -ᾶν (Doric form of Ἑρμῆς), 
Hermas, a Christian: Romains 16:14.†

G2058.def:
ἑρμηνεία, see: ἑρμηνία.
ἑρμηνία (T, cl., -εία), -ας, ἡ, 
(ἑρμηνεύω), [in LXX (-εία), Sir, prol. 14 Sir.47:17, from LXX Sir.5:1 * ;] 
interpretation: 1 Corinthiens 12:10 14:26.†

G2059.def:
ἑρμηνεύω 
[in LXX: Esther 4:7 (תִּרְגַּם), Esther 10:3 Job 42:17β* ;] 
__1. to explain. 
__2. to interpret: Luc 24:27 (WH, mg.), Jean 1:39, 43 9:7, Hébreux 7:2.†

G2061.def:
Ἑρμογένης, -ους, ὁ 
Hermogenes, a Christian: 2 Timothée 1:15.†

G2062.def:
ἑρπετόν, -οῦ, τό
(ἕρπω, to crawl), [in LXX chiefly for רֶמֶשׂ, שֶׁרֶץ ;] 
a creeping thing, reptile: Actes 10:12 11:6, Romains 1:23, Jacques 3:7.†

G2063.def:
ἐρυθρός, -ά, -όν 
[in LXX for אֱדֹם, Ésaïe 63:2; ἐ. θάλασσα for סוּף -יָם Exode 10:19, al. ;] 
red: ἡ ἐ. θάλασσα, the Red Sea, Actes 7:36, Hébreux 11:29.†

G2065.def:
ἐρωτάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַל ;] 
__1. to ask, question (cl.): absol., Luc 19:31 22:68, Jean 8:7 with accusative of person(s), Jean 9:21 16:19, 30 8:21; before λέγων, Matthieu 16:13, Luc 23:3, Jean 1:19, 21 5:12 9:19 16:5; with dupl. accusative (WM, § 32, 4a), Matthieu 21:24, Marc 4:10, Luc 20:3, Jean 16:23 (M, Pr., 66„); with accusative of person(s), before περί, Luc 9:45, Jean 18:19. 
__2. In late Gk. (Milligan, NTD, 51; not, as Cremer, 716, Thayer, see word, a "Hebraism"), = αἰτέω (which see), to ask, request: with accusative of person(s), Jean 14:16; before imperat., Luc 14:18-19 Philippiens 4:3; λέγων, Matthieu 15:23, Jean 12:21; before ἵνα (M, Pr., 208), Marc 7:26, Luc 7:36 16:27, Jean 4:47 17:15 19:31, 38, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:1, 2Jn.5; ὅπως, Luc 7:3 11:37, Actes 23:20; with inf., Luc 5:3 8:37, Jean 4:40, Actes 3:3 10:48 23:18, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:12; with accusative of person(s), before περί, Luc 4:38 Jean 17:9, 20, 1 Jean 5:16; ὑπέρ, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:1-2; τὰ (WH, txt., om. τὰ) πρὸς εἰρήνην, Luc 14:32 (cf. δι-, ἐπ-ερωτάω) 
SYN.: see: αἰτέω

G2066.def:
ἐσθής, -ῆτος, ἡ
(ἕννυμι, to clothe; hence, ἐσθής, Lk, ll with, Elz.) [in LXX: 1Es.8:71 Esther 8:73, 2Ma.8:35 2Mac 11:8 * ;] 
clothing, raiment: Luc 23:11 24:4, Actes 10:30 12:21, Jacques 2:2-3.†

G2068.def:
ἐσθίω, and (poet, and late prose) ἔσθω, 
[in LXX chiefly for אכל ;] 
to eat; 
__(a) absol.: Matthieu 14:20, 21 Marc 6:31, Jean 4:31, al.; ἐν τ. φαγεῖν (on this aor. form, see M, Pr., 111), 1 Corinthiens 11:21; διδόναι φαγεῖν, with dative of person(s), Marc 5:43, al.; ἐ. καὶ πίνειν, Matthieu 6:25, 31 Luc 10:7, al.; of ordinary use of food and drink, 1 Corinthiens 9:4 11:22; of partaking of food at table, Marc 2:16, Luc 5:30, al.; opposite to fasting, Matthieu 11:18, Luc 5:33, al.; of revelling, Matthieu 24:49, Luc 12:45 . 
__(b) with accusative of thing(s): Matthieu 6:25, Marc 1:6, Jean 6:31, Romains 14:2, al.; ἄρτον (Heb. אָכַל לֶחֶם), Matthieu 15:2, Marc 3:20, al.; τὸν ἑαυτοῦ ἄ., 2 Thessaloniciens 3:12; ἄ. before παρά, genitive of person(s), 2 Thessaloniciens 3:8; τά before id., Luc 10:7; τ. πάσχα, Matthieu 26:17, Marc 14:12 al; τ. κυριακὸν δεῖπνον, 1 Corinthiens 11:20; τ. θυσίας, 1 Corinthiens 10:18; before ἐκ (= cl. part. genitive), Jean 6:26, 5o, 51, 1 Corinthiens 11:28; ἀπό (cf. Heb. אָכַל מִן), Matthieu 15:27, Marc 7:28; metaphorically, to devour, consume: Hébreux 10:27, Jacques 5:3, Apocalypse 17:16 (cf. κατ-, συν-εσθίω) .

G2069.def:
Ἐσλεί (Rec. 'Ἐσλί, see WH, Notes, 155), ὁ, 
Esli, an ancestor of Jesus: Luc 3:25.†

G2072.def:
ἔσ-οπτρον, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Wis.7:26, Sir.12:11 * ;] 
a mirror: 1 Corinthiens 13:12, Jacques 1:23.†

G2073.def:
ἑσπέρα, -ας, ἡ
(prop, fem, of ἕσπερος), [in LXX chiefly for עָרַב ;] 
__(a) (sc. ὥρα), evening: Luc 24:29, Actes 4:3 20:15 28:23; 
__(b) (so. χώρα), the west.†

G2074.def:
Ἑσρώμ 
(Ἑσρών, Lk, l.with; Rec. Ἑσρ-), ὁ (Heb. חֶצְרוֹן, Genèse 46:12, Nombres 26:21, 1 Chroniques 25:1-31, al.), [in LXX both forms, ut supr. (cf. ICC, on Mt, l.with; WH, § 408) ;] 
Esrom (AV), Hezron (RV), an ancestor of Jesus: Matthieu 13:1-58, Luc 3:35.†

G2079.def:
ἐσχάτως 
adv., 
extremely, utterly; ἐ. ἔχειν (= Lat. in extremis esse), only in late writers (cf. ἐν ἐσχάτοις εἶναι, FlJ, Ant., ix, 8, 6), to be at the point of death: Marc 5:28.†

G2080.def:
ἔσω Ion, and old Att.. form of εἴσω 
(εἰς), 
adv., [in LXX for etc. ;] 
__1. prop., after verbs of motion (to) within, into: Matthieu 26:58, Marc 14:54; with genitive, Marc 15:16. 
__2. As frequently in cl. (= cl. ἔνδον), after verbs of rest, within: Jean 20:26, Actes 5:23; οἱ ἔ. (opposite to οἱ ἔξω), 1 Corinthiens 5:12; ὁ ἔ. ἄνθρωπος, Romains 7:22, 2 Corinthiens 4:16, Éphésiens 3:16.†

G2081.def:
ἔσωθεν
(ἔσω), 
adv., [in LXX for בַּיִת, פָּנִים and cognate forms ;] 
__1. from within: Marc 7:21, 23, Luc 11:7. 
__2. within: Matthieu 7:15 23:25-28, 2 Corinthiens 7:5, Apocalypse 4:8 5:1; τὸ ἔ., Luc 11:40; id. with genitive, Luc 11:39.†

G2082.def:
ἐσώτερος, -α, -ον
(compar. of ἔσω), [in LXX chiefly for פְּנִימִי and cognate forms ;] 
inner: Actes 16:24; τὸ ἐ., Hébreux 6:19.†

G2083.def:
ἑταῖρος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for רֵעַ and cognate forms, also Sir.11:6 37:2 ff., al. ;] 
a companion, comrade: Matthieu 11:16 (WH, ἑτέροις); voc., as term of address, my friend: Matthieu 20:13 22:12 26:50.†

G2084.def:
ἑτερό-γλωσσος
(Att.. -ττος), -ον, [in Aq.: Psaumes 114:1, Ésaïe 33:19 * ;] 
of alien speech, of another tongue (see Cremer, 681): 1 Corinthiens 14:21 (aliter in LXX).†

G2085.def:
ἑτεροδιδασκαλέω, -ῶ 
to teach other or different doctrine: 1 Timothée 1:3 6:3 (cf. CGT, in l; Milligan, NTD, 102).†

G2086.def:
ἑτερο-ζυγέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX cf. ἑτερόζυγος, Lévitique 19:19 (יְקַמְעָם)* ;] 
to be unequally yoked: metaphorically, with dative of person(s), 2 Corinthiens 6:14.†

G2091.def:
ἑτοιμασία, -ας, ἡ
(ἑτοιμάζω, which see), [in LXX for כּוּן hi., כֵּן, מָכוֹן, and cognate forms, Esther 2:68 3:3, Psaumes 10:17 65:9 89:14, Nahum 2:4, Zacharie 5:11, Eze.43:11, Da TH Daniel 11:7, 20-21, Wis.13:12 * ;] 
__1. = ἑτοιμότης, 
__(a) readiness (Hipp.); 
__(b) preparation (LXX; e.g. ἑ. τ. καρδίας, Psaumes 10:17): Éphésiens 6:15, EV. 
__2. foundation, firm footing (Psaumes 89:14): Eph, l.with (Hatch, Essays, 55; Exp. Times, ix, 38; but see also Abbott, Essays, 95).†

G2093.def:
ἑτοίμως, 
adv. [in LXX: Esther 7:17 ff, Dan LXX TH Daniel 3:15 * ;] 
readily: 1 Pierre 4:5; ἑ. ἔχω, to be ready (Deiss., BS, 252; MM, Exp., xiv): with inf., Actes 21:13, 2 Corinthiens 12:14.†

G2094.def:
ἔτος, -ους, τό 
[in LXX for שָׁנֶה ;] 
a year: Luc 3:1, Hébreux 1:12, Apocalypse 20:3, al.; ἔτη ἔχειν, Jean 5:5 8:57; εἶναι, γίνεσθαι, ἐτῶν, Marc 5:42, Luc 2:42, Actes 4:22, 1 Timothée 5:9; dative pl. of space of time, Jean 2:20, Actes 13:20; accusative, in ans. to how long? Matthieu 9:20, Marc 5:25, Luc 2:36, Actes 7:6, Hébreux 3:9, al.; preceded by a prep.: dim, Luc 8:43, Romains 15:23; διά, with genitive (see: διά), Actes 24:17, Galates 2:1; ἐκ, Actes 24:10; εἰς, Luc 12:19; ἐπί, with accusative, Actes 19:10; μετά, with accusative, Galates 1:18 3:17; πρό, with genitive, 2 Corinthiens 12:2; κατ᾽ ἔτος, yearly, Luc 2:41 
SYN.: ἐνιαυτός, which see; cf. LS, see word ἐνιαυτός

G2095.def:
εὖ 
adv. (prop. neuter of old Epic ἐΰς, good, noble) [in LXX, εὖ γίγνεσθαι, εὖ ποιεῖν (יָטַב) ;] 
well: εὖ γιν., Éphésiens 6:3 (LXX); εὖ ποιεῖν, with dative (cf. Sir.12:1-2), to do good, Marc 14:7 (where Nestle suggests εὐποιεῖν, which see); εὖ πράσστειν, to fare well, Actes 15:29; in replies (= εὖγε), good! well done! Matthieu 25:21, 23 Luc 19:17 (εὖγε, WH, txt.).†
εὖ-γε, 
adv., 
in replies, well! good! well done!: Luc 19:17 (WH for Rec. εὖ, which see).†

G2096.def:
Εὔα (WH, Εὔα, § 408; Rec. Εὖα; S (in I Ti), Εὖα), -ας, ἡ (Heb. חַוָּה, Genèse 3:20), 
Eve, wife of Adam: 2 Corinthiens 11:3, 1 Timothée 2:13.†

G2097.def:
εὐαγγελίζω 
[in LXX for בָּשַׂר pi., hith.; for good news in general: 1 Rois 31:9, al.; of God's loving kindness, Psaumes 40:10 96:2, and esp. of Messianic blessings, Ésaïe 40:9 60:6, al. ;] 
to bring or announce glad tidings; 
__1. act. (only in late writers): with accusative of person(s), Apocalypse 10:7; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Apocalypse 14:6; pass., of things, to be proclaimed as glad tidings: Luc 16:16, Galates 1:11, 1 Pierre 1:25; impers., 1 Pierre 4:6; of persons, to have glad tidings proclaimed to one: Matthieu 11:5, Luc 7:22, Hébreux 4:2, 6 
__2. Depon. mid. (cl.), to proclaim glad tidings, in NT esp. of the Christian message of salvation: absol., Luc 9:6, Romains 15:20, al.; with dative of person(s), Luc 4:18 (LXX), Romains 1:15, al.; in same sense with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), Luc 3:18, Actes 16:10, Galates 1:9, 1 Pierre 1:12; with accusative of thing(s), εἰρήνην, Actes 10:36, Romains 10:15" (LXX) ; τ, βασιλείαν τ. θεοῦ, Luc 8:1; with dative of person(s), Luc 1:19 4:43, Éphésiens 2:17 3:8; αὐτῷ τ. Ἰησοῦν, Actes 8:35 17:18; with dupl. accusative, Actes 13:32; with accusative of person(s) and inf., Actes 14:15; τ. κώμας (πολεῖς), Actes 8:25, 40 14:21 (cf. προ-ευαγγελίζομαι)

G2098.def:
εὐαγγέλιον, -ου, τό 
[in LXX for בְּשׂוֹרָה, 2 Rois 4:10 18:22 18:25 * ;] 
__1. in cl., 
__(a) a reward for good tidings (Hom.; pl., LXX, 2 Rois 4:10); 
__(b) in pl., εὐ. θύειν, to make a thank-offering for good tidings (Xen., al.). 
__2. Later (Luc., Plut., al.), good tidings, good news; in NT of the good tidings of the kingdom of God and of salvation through Christ, the gospel: Marc 1:15, Actes 15:7, Romains 1:16, Galates 2:2, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:4, al.; with genitive obj., τ. βασιλείας, Matthieu 4:23; τ. Χριστοῦ, Romains 15:19, al.; τ. κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ, 2 Thessaloniciens 1:8; τ. υἱοῦ τ. θεοῦ, Romains 1:9; τ. δόξης τ. μακαρίου θεοῦ, 1 Timothée 1:11; τ. δόξης τ. Χριστοῦ, 2 Corinthiens 4:4; of the author, τ. θεοῦ, Romains 15:16, al.; of the teacher, ἡμῶν, Romains 2:16, 2 Corinthiens 4:3, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:5, 2 Timothée 2:8; of the taught, τ. περιτομῆς, τ. ἀκροβυστίας, Galates 2:7; ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ εὐ., Galates 2:5, 14 Colossiens 1:5; ἡ ἐλπὶς (πίστις) τοῦ εὐ., Colossiens 1:23, Philippiens 1:27 (see Cremer, 31 ff.; and on the later eccl. use of the word„ M, Th., 143 f.)
